summary: IdentityDocumentServicesUI provides the authorization UI that an identity document provider app shows during a presentment request, plus the web presentment controller that browsers use. It is the UI layer of IdentityDocumentServices, so it has no BifrOSt counterpart for the same reasons.

features.note: Extension scene for approving a document request
Browser side of the Digital Credentials API
Presents the system authorization sheet over the app

gaps: No identity document authorization sheet or web presentment controller (n/a: same dependency on Apple wallet documents as IdentityDocumentServices)
